label: SIMULATION: logical ticks, no hardware, no wall clock, no network, no ROS 2

scenarios.description: valid commands pass every check and are dispatched
scenarios.name: baseline_valid

scenarios.description: a reply delayed past its expiry is rejected; a late reply after the watchdog hold finds the gate holding
scenarios.name: delayed_reply

scenarios.description: seq 2 arrives before seq 1: seq 2 is allowed, the late seq 1 is never dispatched
scenarios.name: reordered_packet

scenarios.description: one message delivered three times is dispatched once
scenarios.name: duplicate_packet

scenarios.description: link goes down: messages are lost, the watchdog puts the gate in HOLD; the HOLD persists after the link returns until a new epoch is granted and the operator resumes
scenarios.name: disconnection

scenarios.description: the gate process restarts: it takes a new epoch from the durable store, so pre-crash messages (even with unseen sequence numbers) cannot be replayed
scenarios.name: process_crash_replay

scenarios.description: the gate restarts and the epoch store is gone: the gate LOCKS (holds everything) and only an explicit operator reset with an epoch floor reopens it
scenarios.name: process_crash_state_lost

scenarios.description: cmd_vel, shell, near-miss spellings and control characters are not on the skill allow-list; none advances the sequence, a valid command afterwards still works
scenarios.name: unknown_skill

scenarios.description: argument and envelope shapes an LLM might emit (wrong types, NaN, huge numbers, extra keys, nested objects, bad JSON); every one is a typed block, none advances state, and a valid command afterwards is still allowed
scenarios.name: llm_invalid_args

scenarios.description: observation age is half-open: age 4 passes, age 5 (== ttl) is stale; unknown and expired-message cases are distinct typed reasons
scenarios.name: expired_observation

scenarios.description: an operator takes over: commands are held as INTERVENTION_ACTIVE; release leads to HOLD (not autonomous); safe-stop latches until reset; resume is explicit
scenarios.name: operator_intervention

scenarios.description: unapproved model or revision, rogue source, out-of-step and NaN proposals are blocked with model_failure/provenance reasons, then a valid proposal is allowed
scenarios.name: model_failure

scenarios.description: the model stops answering after tick 2: no message arrives, the watchdog HOLDs the gate 8 ticks later and a later message is held
scenarios.name: model_silent_watchdog

scenarios.description: an allow-listed skill that is disabled, and non-simulated control domains, are unavailable_command blocks; only the enabled skill passes
scenarios.name: unavailable_command

scenarios.description: unknown and mismatched modes; explicit equal-tick semantics: created==now ok, created==now+1 future, expires==now expired, expires==now+1 ok, bounded expiry
scenarios.name: modes_and_boundaries
